summary: The stored human slot is the eleven after automatic substitutes. João Pedro was started by four of his seven owners in Gameweek 5, then replaced by a midfielder. The submitted human elevens have 10 zero-minute starters, not 0. The model does the same replacement from a three-forward eleven: the next midfielder or defender who played comes in, and the only forward in an eleven is not replaced by an outfielder. No score change.
